channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: French citizenships fall after new rule blocking retirees
item.description: A new rule on French income that effectively excludes foreign retirees from ever becoming French has led to a significant fall in the number of people being naturalised, according to the Interior Ministry.

item.title: New figures reveal sharp rise in Americans moving to France
item.description: The latest figures from the French government show a 14 percent year-on-year increase in Americans moving to France.

item.title: French eyewear maker in spotlight after presidential showing
item.description: The aviator sunglasses that captured the world's attention when French President Emmanuel Macron wore a pair on stage in Davos in a faceoff with US counterpart Donald Trump have become an unexpected success for the Italian owner of the France-based manufacturer that has watched sales soar.

item.title: French expression of the day: Se prendre la tête
item.description: Why, in France, 'grabbing your head' isn't recommended.

item.title: EU delays full rollout of EES border system over travel chaos concerns
item.description: The deadline for the full implementation of the Europe's Entry/Exit System (EES), the new EU digital border system, has been postponed from April to September amid concerns over travel disruptions during the summer season, a European Commission spokesperson said on Friday.

item.title: Inside France: Family-friendly France, American tech boycott and Minitel
item.description: From the ongoing game of musical chairs that is French politics right now to the move to replace American tech with French products, via France's family-friendly reputation, Inside France is our weekly look at the latest news and talking points from France.

item.title: France rescues over 6,000 UK-bound Channel migrants in 2025
item.description: French authorities rescued more than 6,000 migrants attempting to reach Britain in small boats last year, while 25 people died and two remain missing, the maritime prefecture said Friday in its annual report.

item.title: France tightens infant formula rules after toxin scare
item.description: France plans to impose stricter limits on the acceptable level of a toxin called cereulide in infant formula after potentially contaminated products were recalled over 60 countries.

item.title: Everything that changes in France in February 2026
item.description: From decreasing electricity and gas prices to the famous French crêpes day and the country's biggest farm show, here is what is on the agenda for February 2026 in France.

item.title: Thousands rally in France in support of cash-strapped police
item.description: Thousands of protesters including far-right politicians rallied across France on Saturday in support of the country's cash-strapped police force, with some of the demonstrators launching smoke bombs and blowing whistles.
